intro: The complete work-from-home setup guide for Filipino online professionals. Check what you have. Plan what to buy. All in ₱ (prices sampled July 2026; check current listings before buying).
creed: You don't need perfect. You need prepared. Your equipment doesn't define your skill, but being prepared shows your client you're professional.

categories.name: Laptop / Computer
categories.note: Your single most important tool. Aim for 8GB+ RAM and an SSD.

categories.name: Internet Connection
categories.note: Stable matters more than fast. 25 Mbps+ and a backup are ideal.

tiers.item: Prepaid pocket WiFi / mobile data as failover

categories.name: Power Backup
categories.note: Brownouts happen. A UPS or power station keeps you online mid-call.

categories.name: Headset
categories.note: Clear audio signals professionalism. Get a noise-cancelling mic.

categories.name: Webcam
categories.note: Most laptop cams are fine to start. Upgrade for client-facing roles.

tiers.item: Webcam + ring light for great lighting

categories.name: Second Monitor
categories.note: A huge productivity boost once you're working. Not needed to start.

categories.name: Ergonomic Setup
categories.note: You'll sit here for years. Protect your back and wrists.

categories.name: Focus Lighting
categories.note: Light is a focus tool, especially on night shifts. Bright, cool-white light on your desk keeps you alert while you work. A soft light behind the monitor cuts the screen-vs-dark-room contrast that tires your eyes. Never work facing a dark room with only the screen lit.

tiers.item: Adjustable desk lamp + LED bias strip behind the monitor
Monitor light bar + smart bias lighting

builds.name: The Starter
builds.desc: Refurb laptop, wired headset, backup data, basic UPS. Enough to get hired.
builds.for: Absolute beginners on a tight budget.

builds.name: The Standard
builds.desc: New mid laptop, fiber, NC headset, 1080p webcam, mini power station.
builds.for: Serious about landing and keeping clients.

builds.name: The Pro
builds.desc: 16GB laptop, dual monitor, premium audio, big power station, ergo chair.
builds.for: Specialists in design, video, dev, or automation.
